title: Business Central Trivia Recap: November 2–6, 2026
summary: Recap of the Business Central Trivia round from November 2 to 6, 2026: 250 questions, with 53% answered correctly, up from 47% the week before. BC Acronyms, Intercompany and Development were the hardest categories; Purchase Management, Sales Management and General Ledger and Posting were the easiest. The site added 11 new badge types and clearer answering on slow connections.
key_points: Weekly trivia quiz with 250 questions achieved 53% correct answer rate; top player got 145 correct
Purchase Management and Sales Management were easiest categories (67-69% correct); BC Acronyms and Intercompany were hardest (23-33% correct)
Site improvements include 11 new badge types for achievements like Specialist and Climber, plus better connection handling for slow networks

quotes.text: 53% of the answers were correct, up from 47% last week.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows improvement in player performance and quiz quality across weeks

quotes.text: Bug hunter is a badge you can get when a question report you send leads to a fix.
